programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - 1944-1945'. Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht.

programme.title: Royal Autopsy
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Elizabeth I'. Prof Alice Roberts explores the final dying days and ultimate cause of death of Queen Elizabeth I. With leading forensic pathologist Dr Brett Lockyer, she conducts an 'as real' post mortem exam.

programme.title: The Last King Behind The Iron Curtain
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. This is the never before told story of Romania's 23-year-old King Michael who, by defying Hitler in WW2, risked his life, only to be ejected from his homeland by Communists imposed from the Kremlin.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E8 - Swamp Vets'. Jacob and Little Willie hunt a legendary cannibal gator known as Bone Crusher. Bruce and Anna hide their lines to stay one step ahead of poachers, forcing Bruce to rely on his uncanny swamp memory.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Divine Discoveries'. Secrets of popes, rewritten laws, and cities lost to the waves - these divine discoveries shake our beliefs and uncover mysteries of truly epic proportions.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E9 - Terrors Of The Deep'. For years, there have been reports of creatures living deep beneath the surface of our oceans. The stories include sightings of giant sharks and even razor-toothed mermaids.

programme.title: Great African Crimes With Mandy Wiener
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Maria Mouton'. Maria Mouton - The only white woman executed in the 18th century Cape Colony. Found guilty of murdering her husband with the help of two enslaved people - one of whom she was having an affair with.

programme.title: Mysteries
programme.desc: Presented by John Robbie, Great African Mysteries will unlock the secrets of Africa's past by delving into three major mysteries with fascinating interviews and archival footage.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Hidden Codes'. For centuries, secret codes have been embedded in sacred texts, ancient paintings, and even etched into the earth itself. Were they left as clues or something far more profound?

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Legendary Weapons'. From the legendary blades of ancient kings to a divine arsenal said to annihilate monsters, history is filled with tales of sacred weapons. We delve into how they were crafted and who wielded them.
